title: SheWell
tagline: SheWell is a Web3 app empowering women by offering secure tracking of reproductive health and personalized wellness tips powered by AI. Featuring P2P support, data privacy, incentives and token rewards for data sharing, it redefines women’s health management through Blockchain
description:
SheWell is a groundbreaking Web3 application designed to empower women by offering comprehensive tracking of reproductive health, personalized wellness insights, and a supportive community. Here’s what makes SheWell unique:

Key Features:

1- Menstrual Cycle Tracking: Record women’s menstrual cycles, symptoms, and physical and emotional changes to identify patterns and predict future cycles accurately.

2- Personalized Wellness Insights:
- Ovulation and Fertility Monitoring: Utilize tools to track ovulation, including basal temperature charts and cervical mucus analysis, aiding in family planning.
- Lifestyle Tracking: Log data on diet, exercise, sleep, and stress to see how these factors affect your reproductive health.
- Tailored Recommendations: Get advice on the best times for various activities, from work tasks to physical exercises, based on your cycle phase.

3- Supportive Community:
- Peer-to-Peer Support: Connect with other women for emotional support and shared experiences through secure, anonymous communication.
- Group Activities and Networking: Participate in group discussions and collaborative activities to enhance your social and professional life.

4- Privacy and Data Security:
- Blockchain Security: Ensure women’s personal and medical data remains private and secure, accessible only to you and authorized individuals.
- Tokenized Data Sharing: Earn rewards for securely sharing their anonymized data to help train 
AI models benefiting the broader community.

5- AI-Enhanced Features: We leverage AI to provide deeper health insights and personalized recommendations based on women’s unique data.

6- Marketplace for Data: We will create a marketplace where women can sell their anonymized data, empowering users to benefit from their own information.

*Phase I Development Goals for the Hackathon:
Develop the core features of cycle calendar tracking.
Implement the AI-powered personalized wellness insights.
how_its_made:
Technologies Used:

1- Data Storage:
- Filecoin & IPFS: These decentralized storage solutions are used to encrypt and store sensitive user data securely. By leveraging these technologies, we ensure that data is both highly secure and easily accessible when needed, providing users with peace of mind regarding their privacy.

2- Artificial Intelligence:
- OpenAI: AI is utilized to deliver daily personalized health recommendations. By analyzing user data, OpenAI’s advanced algorithms provide insights and tips tailored to individual health needs and goals, making the app highly adaptive and user-centric.

3- Front-End Development:
- Next.js: Chosen for its ability to create a seamless, intuitive webapp application that works efficiently.
- RestAPI: Used for efficient data querying, ensuring the app remains responsive and data retrieval is optimized.

4- Backend Development:
- Smart Contract: Everything has a key peace, and here is the smart contract to manage all the information for every user.

Notable Hacks and Innovations:
- Decentralized Storage Integration: The combination of Filecoin and IPFS for encrypted data storage is a particularly innovative approach, ensuring that user data remains secure and private while still being easily accessible when needed.
- AI Personalization: Using OpenAI to analyze and provide daily recommendations is a unique feature that leverages AI technology to offer real-time, actionable health insights to users.
